reports.title: National Labour Force Survey (劳动力调查)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: NBS's monthly household labour-force survey (劳动力调查), the statistical survey system (统计调查制度) approved by the State Council under which employment and unemployment data are collected from about 340,000 urban and rural households across all 31 provinces each month. NBS's own indicator note states: "劳动力调查是国务院批准建立的一项重要统计调查制度，由国家统计局负责组织实施，用于搜集全国城乡劳动力的就业失业数据。劳动力调查的频率为月度". Minted 2026-09-05 because NBS names it as the source of the surveyed unemployment rate; the survey system document itself is republished annually on NBS's 统计调查制度 page (2026 edition cited as url).
reports.cadence_note: Monthly fieldwork (2-10-2 sample rotation); results are published through the surveyed unemployment rate rather than as a standalone release. The survey system document (劳动力调查制度) is reissued annually.

dependencies.basis: RESEARCHED 2026-09-05 (publisher-cluster lead research, NBS). REVERSED from the lead 'cn-gdp-national-accounts -> cn-provincial-gdp': NBS's 统计知识 page 《地区生产总值统一核算如何实施》 describes unified accounting (2020 reform) as NBS organising provincial GDP accounting so that the provincial sum reconciles (衔接) to national GDP, with provinces no longer reporting their own figures — the provincial series is compiled under, and reconciled to, the national accounts. Reconciliation language rather than 'compiled from' — the dependency is on the national accounts framework and total, not on a figure copied across. dependencies.evidence_quote: 通过统一核算，实现了地区生产总值汇总数与国内生产总值基本衔接。实施统一核算后，各省（区、市）统计局不再上报本地区生产总值数据。
